saw_lines: Buyers of AI video tools try two or three before paying, and they judge on the first clip they make.
So the free trial must sit in the ad itself, because a buyer comparing tools rarely clicks through to find it.
Your site lists a 4.8 rating, so test that number as the opening line of three new video ads, since 3 of 44 Google creatives are video.
ads_1: Short AI video demos built around the free trial and the first clip
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, Twitter, X and Youtube
